measures.title: Charter Amendment: Gender Neutrality
measures.summary: The Howard County Charter uses gender-specific words such as "he" and "she." This amendment would replace them with gender-neutral words such as "they" and "them."
measures.yesMeans: For: the Charter's gender-specific words are replaced with gender-neutral words.
measures.noMeans: Against: the gender-specific words in the Charter stay unchanged.

measures.title: Charter Amendment: Affordable For-Sale Housing Projects
measures.summary: Today the Charter lets the County use its capital budget to finance an affordable housing project in its Housing Opportunities Trust Fund only if the County owns the project. This amendment would allow capital budget financing for projects that contain only for-sale housing units and are owned by the Howard County Housing Commission or an entity it controls. The County would repay the bonds over a set period, typically 20-30 years, and the units must stay affordable for that period.
measures.yesMeans: For: the County may use its capital budget to finance these affordable for-sale housing projects.
measures.noMeans: Against: these affordable for-sale housing projects must be financed some other way than the County's capital budget.
